procedure: Bind the executing tool to the requested host, guest, container or remote runtime.
criterion: The target relationship is supported by specific evidence; aliases alone are insufficient.
boundary: Selected target only.

procedure: Match browser, profile ID and live context.
criterion: Saved and live observations refer to the same identified profile.
boundary: Do not inspect other profiles.

procedure: Record purpose and intended time, route, persistence and function policies.
criterion: Requirements are established; unresolved preferences remain unknown.
boundary: Use existing user instructions and managed policy.

procedure: Record available access and action-specific authorization.
criterion: Each performed action is within scope; unavailable permissions are explicit.
boundary: No authority inferred from a tool being installed.

procedure: Read OS family, release and architecture using bounded local inspection.
criterion: Readings identify the executing environment without falsely identifying the physical device.
boundary: No hardware serials, usernames or hostname required.

procedure: Record full browser, profile-manager, kernel and relevant patch builds.
criterion: Versions describe the active installation and selected profile, not just the UA string.
boundary: Prefer existing About/version UI or selected metadata.

procedure: Compare active builds with the applicable current vendor support channel.
criterion: Support and update conclusions are supported by current official documentation.
boundary: No update installation during a read-only audit.

procedure: Review install provenance and managed/security settings relevant to the browser.
criterion: The source and applicable controls are known and align with the approved policy.
boundary: No whole-system forensic inventory or certificate private-key access.

procedure: Inspect host time and synchronization configuration; distinguish state from measured accuracy.
criterion: The stated clock policy is met; synchronization enabled alone does not prove accuracy.
boundary: External time measurement needs approved network scope.

procedure: Compare host timezone, saved profile timezone, launch override and live Intl/Date output.
criterion: The responsible layer and returned timezone implement the established time policy.
boundary: An IP/device timezone difference alone is not a defect.

procedure: Check timezone name and signed offset for the same instant; account for seasonal rules.
criterion: Offsets are explainable under the named zone and timestamp, including fractional-hour zones.
boundary: No permanent offset inferred from a single seasonal sample.

procedure: Confirm the selected data directory/profile persistence policy.
criterion: Work and test state boundaries match the declared purpose.
boundary: Do not copy authenticated profiles or credential stores.

procedure: Inspect relevant OS, manager, policy, extension and launch overrides.
criterion: Each material override has an identified source; unexplained conflicts are recorded.
boundary: Allowlist launch fields before output; do not dump full arguments.

procedure: Compare saved selections with active process and page readings.
criterion: Current observations implement the intended saved state or a documented exception.
boundary: A fresh launch requires separate lifecycle approval.

procedure: Record proxy type, redacted endpoint, configuration layer and authentication mechanism.
criterion: The configured mechanism is supported by the actual browser implementation.
boundary: Never read or print the proxy password; record presence/mechanism only.

procedure: Observe an approved fresh exit-IP request from the target browser context.
criterion: The tested request follows the intended route; destination, time and IP family are recorded.
boundary: External request authorization; terminal results are separate evidence.

procedure: Inspect relevant VPN/tunnel, PAC, bypass and split-routing configuration.
criterion: Effective routing rules match the network policy and explain exceptions.
boundary: Do not fetch unknown PAC URLs or expose internal domain lists.

procedure: Assess DNS configuration and, when approved, resolution behavior on the tested route.
criterion: Observed name resolution follows the policy within the documented test scope.
boundary: No DNS-leak verdict from an IP-only check.

procedure: Inspect and separately test relevant IPv4 and IPv6 behavior.
criterion: Each applicable address family follows the route policy or has an explained unavailable state.
boundary: Do not disable IPv6 merely to improve a checker result.

procedure: Inspect WebRTC/UDP policy and test required behavior when authorized.
criterion: Approved tests support both the stated exposure policy and required real-time functions.
boundary: No STUN calls, ICE collection or permission prompts by default.

procedure: Test loss of proxy connectivity in an explicitly approved disposable signed-out context.
criterion: Failure behavior matches the declared policy, including fail-closed when required.
boundary: Never interrupt an active work session for this test without approval.

procedure: Inspect HTTPS/certificate-validation settings and relevant connection failures.
criterion: Required connections use the approved trust model without unapproved validation bypass.
boundary: No private-key reads, certificate installation or packet capture by default.

procedure: Compare UA/platform/Client Hints with selected build and intended environment.
criterion: Differences are explained by the baseline and implementation; contradictions remain review items.
boundary: Do not fabricate a replacement identity.

procedure: Compare allowlisted request identity headers with page-visible values when authorized.
criterion: Differences are evaluated with context, privacy reduction and hint availability accounted for.
boundary: No full HAR, Cookie, Authorization, Referer or response-body export.

procedure: Review language order, formatting locale and applicable language headers.
criterion: Actual language behavior matches intended preferences and is explained across layers.
boundary: Language is not required to match an exit-IP country.

procedure: Record screen and viewport CSS dimensions, pixel ratio, color depth, zoom conditions and attached-display context.
criterion: Readings are explainable under the display setup and measurement conditions.
boundary: Do not set a conventional resolution purely for appearance.

procedure: Inspect available renderer metadata and custom WebGL/WebGPU overrides.
criterion: Graphics behavior follows the baseline and required functions operate; unknown metadata stays unknown.
boundary: Optional graphics probe only; no synthetic identity editing.

procedure: Interpret logical CPU availability and approximate memory readings.
criterion: No failure is inferred merely from disagreement with a physical specification.
boundary: Do not run benchmarks or enumerate unrelated hardware.

procedure: Review startup regeneration separately from long-lived privacy/noise settings.
criterion: Behavior matches the chosen persistence policy; unintended regeneration is identified.
boundary: Record a recommendation separately from an executed edit.

procedure: Review intended Canvas, fonts, audio, media, rects, voices and related privacy controls.
criterion: Privacy mechanisms and required features are compatible with the stated use.
boundary: No raw fingerprint bundle or media-device enumeration by default.

procedure: Inspect location policy and existing grants for the selected sites.
criterion: Location access follows the user-approved permission policy.
boundary: Do not request actual coordinates or trigger a new permission prompt.

procedure: Check that diagnostic pages and sample origins are approved and consistently identified.
criterion: Origin- or context-dependent observations are not generalized beyond the tested context.
boundary: No upload of full diagnostic results to third parties.

procedure: Inspect cookie/site-data retention settings and clear-on-exit policy.
criterion: Retention configuration matches the declared session policy.
boundary: Do not read stored cookie values, localStorage contents or account databases.

procedure: Review synchronization categories, destinations and access boundaries.
criterion: Data synchronization is intentional and appropriate to the profile purpose.
boundary: No export of live sessions or wholesale profile backups.

procedure: When authorized, test persistence using a disposable non-sensitive marker in a dedicated test origin.
criterion: The benign marker persists or expires as required; test state is tracked and cleaned up as approved.
boundary: This writes test state and requires separate permission; a cookie-enabled flag is insufficient.

procedure: Inventory relevant extensions and their effective site access.
criterion: Every extension and broad permission has an approved purpose.
boundary: No extension disabling or removal in read-only mode.

procedure: Review required camera, microphone, clipboard, files, local network and device permissions.
criterion: Effective grants are no broader than the declared work requirements.
boundary: Do not prompt for or exercise powerful permissions by default.

procedure: Inspect relevant existing debugging, automation and local API exposure.
criterion: Approved interfaces have appropriate binding/access and are separated from sensitive work sessions.
boundary: No enabling debugging, opening ports or scanning networks by default.

procedure: Review relevant browser security controls and any explicit bypasses.
criterion: Active settings meet the approved security baseline; deviations have documented authority.
boundary: Do not disable sandboxing, safe-browsing, TLS checks or site isolation.

procedure: Check collection and output handling for secrets and unnecessary identifiers.
criterion: Reports contain only necessary sanitized facts and evidence references.
boundary: Sensitive values must be excluded before tool responses reach the agent.

procedure: Repeat a minimal probe within the same authorized context.
criterion: Differences are explained using context, timestamp, display conditions and privacy behavior.
boundary: No settings changes or page navigation implied.

procedure: Compare an initial launch and two approved relaunches under recorded conditions.
criterion: Persistent-profile behavior matches the baseline; changes are classified, not merely counted.
boundary: Specific lifecycle approval; otherwise BLOCKED.

procedure: Test only required workflows with benign inputs and approved actions.
criterion: Required functions operate under the chosen network/privacy configuration.
boundary: Uploads, paid calls, messages, account logins and service actions need appropriate authorization.

procedure: Link every local finding to dated, target-bound evidence.
criterion: Documentation supports interpretation and observations support local-state claims.
boundary: Preserve source category and original observation window.

procedure: Produce the full register, coverage, limitations, and proposed changes.
criterion: Every catalog control has an outcome; untested checks are visible and do not pass.
boundary: Do not invent trust scores or service-account predictions.

procedure: Separate observation actions, proposed changes, actual changes and verification.
criterion: The report accurately describes all actions and uses before/after evidence for verified remediation.
boundary: Saving a setting alone does not establish a verified fix.
